metadata.scope: Public-source guide to the Enbridge-associated North American liquids pipeline portfolio: numbered Mainline sections, connected named systems, liquids joint ventures, former asset labels and an explicitly unresolved internal transfer label. Natural-gas transmission and distribution networks are outside this crude/refined-products guide.
metadata.coverage_note: Catalogue entries describe published lines, sections or named systems, not a count of unique physical pipes. Serial sections, parallel pipes, legacy numbers and combined 14/64 service are distinguished. Unresolved and former records do not imply current Enbridge ownership.
metadata.capacity_note: Ratings retain their published basis and date; they are not measured flow, live restrictions, apportionment, nominations or bookable capacity. Ratings for serial sections and combined systems must not be added.
metadata.geometry_note: route_ids are contextual catalogue joins, not coordinate-derived line assignments. Separate Line 7 and Line 11 map features use explicit CER PipelineID attributes. Shared Mainline/EIA corridors do not identify every numbered physical pipe.

metadata.portfolio_coverage: All Crude Oil and Liquids Pipelines assets on printed pages 3-66 of the operator July 28, 2026 catalogue are represented here or in the separate 15-row core Mainline research.
